entries.why: ldr r7, [r4, #0x14] (the range) at the start of the X to scale step mapping of the touch pad, behind the call that returns the steps of the scale; the 44 bytes from here are equal in both
movle r1, #1 in the value change of the page TOUCH SCALE RANGE (getter, add, clamp 1 to 4, setter); the 36 bytes from 0xC007A938 are equal in both
the touch scale object: r4 at the mapping above, +0x14 the range, +0x18 the octave of the keyboard; read out of the running firmware in the emulator
